fields.mechanism: Benchtop NMR analysis for precise structural elucidation and component identification
fields.intervention: Integrate a benchtop NMR system to analyze the contents of sealed micro-vials before and after sampling to ensure correct positioning and prevent jamming
fields.expected_effect: Improved precision in vial indexing and reduced mechanical jamming due to accurate identification and positioning of vials
fields.falsification_test: Conduct a series of tests with varying vial positions and contents, using the NMR system to verify correct identification and positioning, and monitor for any instances of jamming
fields.mechanism_source_span: "The instructional organic chemistry laboratory has been substantially improved through the implementation of benchtop NMR analysis."
